routes.rationale: Homepage is an orientation and discovery surface: it introduces the collection, links to independent stories, offers planning paths and displays credited artwork. It has no sustained subject article to reformat or assign a byline to. Its linked stories remain separate queue entries. Illustration disclosure and media rights remain intact.

The 404 page explains a missing link and offers recovery links to Explore, Home, My journey and subject suggestions. It is interface copy, not an authored subject article. Direct /404.html returned 200; this observation does not establish the response for an arbitrary missing route.

routes.rationale: Explore is a searchable collection with subject, area and ordering controls and linked entry cards. Card summaries and image credits belong to their underlying entries; applying an article byline to the collection would blur those scopes. Individual articles remain in the rollout.

My Odisha Journey is the browser-local planning and export interface: visitors name journeys, arrange saved ideas, write notes and choose downloads. These visitor-created plans are not a Founder-authored article. Source articles and generated reading excerpts retain their own review scopes. No saved visitor data was read or changed.
